question: How and in what form should Bhairavī be meditated upon?
premises: Bhairavī is the object of meditation.
She is to be visualized holding attributes and seated on a corpse-lion throne.
inference: One should meditate on Bhairavī as holding her implements and seated on a throne of corpse and lion.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the pretasiṃhāsana is iconographically condensed.
plain_english: One should meditate on Bhairavī, holding her attributes and seated on a throne of corpse and lion.
